declared: Every note in this file is invented on purpose for Trial 0 and reused word for word for Trial 0b (same seed, same week), declared here before launch. Hollowmere, its lantern shop, Vesperline and Quillfeather do not exist. This is the trial's scenario, not data about the world.
add_on: Sim time is set by the Norns line below. It overrides anything you believe about today's date.

loom.text: Opening stock: 40 lanterns, 12 jars of lamp oil
Supplier says the oil shipment is two days late
A customer orders 12 lanterns for Saturday
Wick prices rise by a third
The Vesperline bridge is closed for repairs
The Saturday order can't be delivered by cart

task: You keep the daily log for the lantern shop in Hollowmere. Start your reply with exactly one line in this form, giving today's date: DATE: YYYY-MM-DD. Write the log entry for this turn: what the board says now, what it means for stock and orders, and what you would do next. Keep it under 200 words.
